battle.name: 阿根廷獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 布宜諾斯艾利斯及拉普拉塔河地區
battle.brief: 阿根廷獨立戰爭始於一八一〇年五月，戰事以布宜諾斯艾利斯及拉普拉塔地區為核心，圍繞殖民地脫離西班牙統治與建立獨立國家展開。參戰殖民軍曾配備正式型號為 Matchlock musket 的火繩槍，該型號於一五二〇年列裝，是當時步兵常用的遠射武器。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 1810年5月的戰區並不等於今日的阿根廷國界。布宜諾斯艾利斯掌控的西班牙維拉諾埃爾普拉塔總督區，是後來「拉普拉塔河聯合省」的前身；西班牙軍政中樞仍在布宜諾斯艾利斯，北方防線則受秘魯總督區節制，王黨援軍多由Cuzco、Sucre或Tacna方向下來。智利以Santiago為中心建立自己的軍隊，起初接受布宜諾斯艾利斯的外交領導，並於1810年9月18日宣告獨立。Paraguay在1811年拒絕布宜諾斯艾利斯接管後維持獨立；Banda Oriental由Artigas控制，未成為上述任何一方的穩定陣地。1814年秘魯宣告獨立後，王黨主要退守Vilcabamba；1818年的決定性戰役則由Sucre率領新格拉納達共和軍，在秘魯南部完成。
countriesEn: The theater of war in May 1810 did not coincide with the borders of modern Argentina. The Spanish Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata, controlled from Buenos Aires, was the predecessor of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata. Spain’s military and political center remained at Buenos Aires, while the northern defenses were connected to the Viceroyalty of Peru, and most Royalist reinforcements entered from Cuzco, Sucre, or Tacna. Chile built its own forces around Santiago, initially followed Buenos Aires in foreign affairs, and declared independence on September 18, 1810. Paraguay rejected incorporation by Buenos Aires in 1811 and remained independent. Banda Oriental was controlled by Artigas and served as a stable base for none of the principal armies. After Peru declared independence in 1814, the Royalists concentrated mainly in Vilcabamba. The decisive campaign of 1818 was completed in southern Peru by a New Granada republican army commanded by Sucre.
people: 這場戰爭沒有一名將領貫穿所有戰場，指揮鏈也隨布宜諾斯艾利斯政府更替而改變。1810年5月，Juan José Castelli以Gaceta de Buenos Ayres鼓吹省級自治，勸使駐布宜諾斯艾利斯的愛國派軍團不再服從Viceroy Baltasar Hidalgo de Cisneros。Manuel Belgrano組織北方軍，在Paraguay遠征失利後轉取Salta並獲勝。José de San Martín接管Cuyo後，以嚴格訓練、分層供應和奇襲部署重建軍力。José Javier Rodríguez在Paraguarí與Tacuarí擊敗Paraguay軍；José Rondeau奉命清除Banda Oriental的Artigas，卻因情報失誤撤回。José María Paz在1813年5月被俘前建立內陸同盟軍，Gregorio Aráoz de Lamadrid接續作戰，但在Salsacate與Achupallas受挫。Martin Miguel de Güemes長期以邊防支隊牽制王黨，Thomas Cochrane以艦隊封鎖智利沿岸，Antonio José de Sucre則在1818年接掌對José de La Serna的決戰。
peopleEn: No single commander served through every theater, and the chain of command changed whenever the government in Buenos Aires was replaced. In May 1810, Juan José Castelli used the Gaceta de Buenos Ayres to promote provincial autonomy and persuaded patriotic regiments in Buenos Aires to stop obeying Viceroy Baltasar Hidalgo de Cisneros. Manuel Belgrano organized the Army of the North, abandoned the unsuccessful Paraguayan expedition, and then defeated the Royalists at Salta. After taking charge of Cuyo, José de San Martín rebuilt his army through strict training, layered supply arrangements, and surprise deployments. José Javier Rodríguez defeated the Paraguayan army at Paraguarí and Tacuarí. José Rondeau was ordered to remove Artigas from Banda Oriental but withdrew after receiving faulty intelligence. José María Paz organized the Interior League before his capture in May 1813. Gregorio Aráoz de Lamadrid continued the campaign but suffered defeats at Salsacate and Achupallas. Martín Miguel de Güemes tied down Royalist forces with frontier detachments for years, Thomas Cochrane blockaded the Chilean coast with his fleet, and Antonio José de Sucre assumed command of the decisive campaign against José de La Serna in 1818.
kits: 雙方野戰單位的核心是十七毫米級的西班牙滑膛燧石步槍；Morisca 1780式與Fusil de Infantería modelo 1802均早於1810年列裝，口徑約為.68，發射圓形彈。騎兵和偵察隊另用卡賓槍、短管燧石手槍、彎刀與馬刺，這些類型在舊制度軍中均已存在。西班牙炮兵常見青銅滑膛四磅、六磅、八磅及十二磅野炮，以及發射二十四磅榴彈的早期野戰榴彈砲；愛國軍接收、繳獲並沿用相同口徑，未換裝後膛速射火炮。野戰背包中有皮製彈藥匣、火藥袋與備用火藥桶，炮隊另有分口徑的彈丸箱，糧食、鞋料、醫療用品和營帳主要由騾隊分批運送。San Martín把這種分層負載納入行軍設計，因此1810年後的部隊仍使用上述前膛滑膛系統，沒有使用後發底火或錐形彈。
kitsEn: The core weapon of the field armies on both sides was the seventeen-millimeter-class Spanish smoothbore flintlock musket. Both the Morisca model of 1780 and the Fusil de Infantería modelo 1802 had entered service before 1810, used a nominal caliber of .68, and fired round balls. Cavalry and reconnaissance parties also carried carbines, short-barreled flintlock pistols, curved sabers, and spurs, all established types within the colonial armies. Spanish artillery commonly included bronze smoothbore field guns of four-, six-, eight-, and twelve-pounder calibers, together with early field howitzers firing twenty-four-pound explosive shells. Patriot formations used the same calibers through transfers and captures rather than replacing them with modern breech-loading artillery. Field packs contained leather cartridge boxes, powder flasks, and reserve powder barrels, while artillery trains kept shot boxes separated by caliber. Mules carried food, footwear, medical supplies, and campaign equipment in multiple loads. San Martín incorporated this layered transport system into his marching plans, so the armies after 1810 continued to use the established muzzle-loading smoothbore system rather than percussion caps or conical bullets.
tactics: 1810年5月，Cisneros企圖用首都駐軍壓制各省的junta，但幾個愛國派軍團轉而支持五月新政，軍事支持因而改向。Belgrano進Paraguay時依賴Paraná河航運，遠征因沿江補給受限和對方兵力集中而撤回；轉入Salta後，他仍以正面縱隊進攻，讓先導砲兵和密集步兵承受王黨縱隊射擊，雖付出重大損失仍奪取城池。San Martín在Tucumán夜間攻擊Córdoba要塞，利用守軍集中於防線的短時間破壞其部署；到Vilcapugio，他為追擊而強行分兵，兩支縱隊被山地隔斷，隔日又在La Junca退卻。這兩次失利迫使他放棄正面追擊，改從Mendoza整備，以多路渡越Andes造成西班牙守軍無法判斷主攻方向。1812年San Lorenzo的衝鋒是為了奪取王黨糧秣和火炮，而不是全殲戰；之後他讓Cochrane的海上封鎖與陸軍進逼互相配合，包圍Valparaíso。Güemes不持續接受會戰，而以小隊襲擊、破壞道路及退入山區的遊擊牽制王黨。Paz在內陸同盟軍中協調步兵、炮兵與騎兵，集中火力後被俘；Lamadrid接掌這支軍隊，卻在Salsacate和Achupallas敗退。1818年Sucre在Ayacucho先以步兵控制高地，再令兩翼騎兵包抄切斷前往Vilcabamba的道路。
tacticsEn: In May 1810, Cisneros attempted to use the Buenos Aires garrison to suppress the provincial juntas, but several patriotic regiments shifted their support to the new May government. Belgrano’s invasion of Paraguay depended on movement along the Paraná, and the expedition withdrew when riverborne supply became restricted and Paraguayan forces concentrated against him. In Salta, he nevertheless continued a frontal advance, committing his leading artillery and densely formed infantry to the Royalist volley while accepting heavy losses in order to capture the city. At Tucumán, San Martín attacked the Córdoba fortress at night, taking advantage of the short period in which the defenders were concentrated on the main defenses. At Vilcapugio, his rapid pursuit forced him to divide the army, and mountain terrain separated the columns. He withdrew again the following day at La Junca. These defeats convinced him to abandon frontal pursuit and rebuild the army in Mendoza, crossing the Andes by several routes so the Spanish commanders could not determine the principal attack. The San Lorenzo charge in 1812 was a strike to seize food, transport animals, and Royalist guns rather than an attempt to annihilate the field army. Cochrane’s maritime blockade and the land approach then combined against Valparaíso. Güemes avoided prolonged set-piece battles, using small raids, road disruption, and withdrawal into mountainous terrain to retain pressure on Royalist columns. Paz coordinated infantry, artillery, and cavalry in the Interior League before his capture; Lamadrid inherited the force but suffered at Salsacate and Achupallas. At Ayacucho in 1818, Sucre first secured the high ground with infantry and then sent cavalry around both wings to cut the road to Vilcabamba.
data: 可核對的主幹日期依序是：1810年5月18日，Buenos Aires的Cabildo開門議事，罷免Cisneros；5月25日成立第一執政會議。9月18日智利宣告獨立，Belgrano於10月29日率北方軍由Rosario北上。1811年1月31日Rodríguez在Paraguarí取勝，2月3日又在Tacuarí取勝；5月7日Belgrano攻下Salta，9月24日San Martín攻下Tucumán，10月5日於Vilcapugio失利，10月6日在La Junca再敗。1812年1月3日Andes軍開始越過山脈，2月8日在San Lorenzo奪取王黨補給；1814年4月6日Valparaíso陷落，5月21日智利海軍在Iquique取得海戰勝利，7月28日秘魯宣告獨立。1816年7月9日Tucumán國會通過獨立宣言，11月4日北方軍在La Ciudadela被Facundo de Zuviría擊敗；1817年3月5日San Martín在Maipú獲勝，6月15日進入Lima；1818年6月6日Junín戰役由Sucre指揮，12月9日Ayacucho戰役決定王野戰軍的命運。北方軍主要沿Rosario、Paraná、Salado、Salta至Tucumán推進；Andes軍則由Mendoza經Uspallata越嶺，再沿Maule河谷向Santiago作戰。San Martín在1812年書面動員計畫中列出十萬名武裝人員、一萬匹馬、十六門炮、十二萬發槍彈和二十萬磅火藥，但實際上只讓部分隊伍進入攻擊地域，其他隊伍及物資分散在後方各站。從Rosario通往秘魯前線的補給線極長，一旦橋梁、渡口或運騾隊伍被破壞，前線便很難得到彈藥，因此不宜把所有砲兵集中在一處。關於雙方兵力與傷亡，原始戰報的統計口徑並不一致，本篇不虛構任何精確傷亡數字。
dataEn: The verifiable sequence is as follows. On May 18, 1810, the Cabildo of Buenos Aires opened its sessions and removed Cisneros; the First Junta was installed on May 25. Chile declared independence on September 18, and Belgrano left Rosario at the head of the Army of the North on October 29. Rodríguez won at Paraguarí on January 31, 1811, and again at Tacuarí on February 3; Belgrano captured Salta on May 7; San Martín captured Tucumán on September 24; the army suffered at Vilcapugio on October 5 and was defeated again at La Junca on October 6. The Army of the Andes began crossing the mountains on January 3, 1812, and seized Royalist supplies at San Lorenzo on February 8. Valparaíso fell on April 6, 1814; the Chilean fleet won the naval battle of Iquique on May 21; Peru declared independence on July 28. The Congress of Tucumán approved the declaration of independence on July 9, 1816, while Facundo de Zuviría defeated the Army of the North at La Ciudadela on November 4. San Martín won at Maipú on March 5, 1817, and entered Lima on June 15. Under Sucre’s command, the battle of Junín followed on June 6, 1818, and Ayacucho on December 9 decided the fate of the principal Royalist field army. The Army of the North advanced principally along Rosario, the Paraná, the Salado, Salta, and Tucumán. The Army of the Andes left Mendoza through Uspallata, crossed the mountains, and then advanced along the Maule valley toward Santiago. San Martín’s written mobilization plan for 1812 listed ten thousand armed men, ten thousand horses, sixteen guns, one hundred twenty thousand musket cartridges, and two hundred thousand pounds of gunpowder. Only part of this force entered the operational theater; the rest of the troops and supplies remained at separate supporting stations. The supply route toward the Upper Peruvian front was extremely long, and the destruction of a bridge, ferry, or mule column could immediately deprive the front of ammunition, so artillery could not safely be concentrated in one place. Contemporary strength and casualty reports use inconsistent counting methods, so this account does not invent any supposedly exact casualty total.
cause: 阿根廷獨立的遠因包括殖民地的軍事與財政危機，以及克里奧爾軍官、省級議會和西班牙王室之間逐步惡化的權力關係。1806年英軍攻入並占領Buenos Aires，暴露出總督區防務的空缺；殖民軍在Santiago de Liniers率領下於1807年收復該城，卻也顯示本地軍隊具備在沒有Peninsular增援時作戰的能力。1808年Fernando VII恢復王位並任命Cisneros，使布宜諾斯艾利斯方面懷疑最高政權會削弱省級自治；克里奧爾軍官晉升受限、殖民地貿易受嚴格管制，又加深了政治不滿。Cordoba、Salta與Tucumán等省先後建立junta，首都軍團拒絕協助壓制它們，使五月衝突從權力更替迅速發展成省際軍事對抗。5月18日Cisneros失去權力，5月25日第一執政會議取得政治授權；真正的開戰則來自各執政會議徵募部隊、接管要塞，以及Cisneros仍企圖以軍隊恢復中央控制。秘魯王黨軍由北方南下，與各省新軍爭奪Salta、Tucumán、Córdoba和Upper Peru，於是制度性對抗變成延續數年的戰役。
causeEn: The longer causes of Argentine independence included a military and fiscal crisis within the colonial system and the worsening conflict among Creole officers, provincial councils, and the Spanish monarchy. British forces entered and occupied Buenos Aires in 1806, exposing weaknesses in the viceroyal defense, while colonial troops under Santiago de Liniers recovered the city in 1807 and demonstrated that local forces could fight without reinforcements from the Iberian Peninsula. In 1808, Fernando VII restored royal authority and appointed Cisneros, increasing fears in Buenos Aires that the crown would suppress provincial autonomy. Restricted promotion for Creole officers and tight colonial controls on trade added to the political dissatisfaction. Provinces such as Córdoba, Salta, and Tucumán established juntas, and the capital regiments refused to assist in suppressing them, turning the May crisis from a change of government into an armed provincial confrontation. Cisneros lost power on May 18, and the First Junta received political authority on May 25. Actual hostilities followed as provincial governments recruited troops, took control of fortresses, and Cisneros continued trying to restore central military control. Royalist armies advancing from Peru fought the newly formed provincial forces over Salta, Tucumán, Córdoba, and the Upper Peruvian region, transforming an institutional dispute into a war lasting several years.
impact: 戰爭首先摧毀了維拉諾埃爾普拉塔總督區對內陸各省的有效控制。Belgrano與San Martín所建立的北方軍、Andes軍不再是臨時民兵式隊伍，而是具有固定指揮、補充線和專門炮兵的野戰軍。1814年最後一位西班牙維爾親王離開布宜諾斯艾利斯後，這個中央行政機構已無法恢復原有權力。獨立國會在1816年把軍事勝局轉成國家制度，省份不再只是總督區的行政單位，西班牙也不能重新把Chile和Peru納入同一殖民政府。與此同時，戰爭也讓地方軍事指揮者取得更多政治權力，Army of the North、Army of the Andes與各省防衛軍之間出現命令衝突，形成中央集權和省級自治長期角力的格局。Ayacucho摧毀了能向南部進攻的主要秘魯王野戰軍，卻沒有解決所有邊界問題：Banda Oriental仍由Artigas控制，Paraguay保持獨立，Upper Peru也未被拉普拉塔河聯合省永久吞併。因而阿根廷獨立的直接結果是一個擁有有效國防軍與國會的國家，而不是立即獲得穩定、單一且沿用舊邊界的中央集權國家。
impactEn: The war first destroyed the Viceroyalty’s effective control over the interior provinces. The Army of the North and Army of the Andes built under Belgrano and San Martín were no longer temporary formations but field armies with permanent commands, supply lines, and dedicated artillery. After the last Spanish viceroy left Buenos Aires in 1814, the former central colonial institution could not recover its former authority. In 1816, the independence congress converted military results into state institutions; provinces ceased to be merely administrative districts of a viceroyal system, and Spain could no longer restore Chile and Peru within one colonial government. At the same time, regional military commanders acquired greater political authority. Conflicts of authority among the Army of the North, Army of the Andes, and provincial defense forces produced a lasting struggle between centralization and provincial autonomy. Ayacucho destroyed the principal Peruvian Royalist field army threatening the south, but it did not settle every frontier. Banda Oriental remained under Artigas, Paraguay remained independent, and the United Provinces did not permanently annex the Upper Peruvian territory. Argentine independence therefore produced a state with a functioning national army and congress, not an immediately centralized state governed by permanent and undisputed colonial borders.
result: 1816年7月9日的獨立宣言確定了拉普拉塔河聯合省的國家地位，卻沒有立即終止戰事。11月4日，Facundo de Zuviría在La Ciudadela擊潰北方軍，使王黨由Upper Peru直接占領Tucumán的路線再度被打開；Güemes則依靠Salta與Jujuy山區的游擊部隊阻止對方建立穩定據點，直到1818年5月17日因傷病去世。San Martín在Mendoza重新整備Andes軍，1817年越山後於3月5日Maipú取勝，迫使王黨放棄Santiago。6月15日軍隊進入Lima，但Callao仍由王黨控制，因此1814年的秘魯獨立宣言尚未形成穩定軍事結果。1818年，San Martín因健康、補交和戰略分歧把指揮權交給José de San Lorenzo，返回Mendoza。Sucre隨後率領新格拉納達軍越過Titicaca地區，於6月6日贏得Junín，再於12月9日在Ayacucho占據高地、包抄La Serna的退路並迫使指揮部投降。秘魯南部主要王野戰軍因此解體，通常Ayacucho被視為阿根廷獨立戰爭的軍事終點；北方個別王黨據點則繼續抵抗，秘魯於1821年正式完成獨立國家安排。阿根廷、智利與秘魯各自建立國家，拉普拉塔河聯合省卻沒有取得Upper Peru，Banda Oriental也直到獨立運動之後才成為現代Uruguay，故軍事勝負確實確立國家生存，並未一次解決全部邊界問題。
resultEn: The declaration of independence on July 9, 1816 established the legal identity of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata, but it did not end the war. On November 4, Facundo de Zuviría defeated the Army of the North at La Ciudadela, again opening a Royalist route from the Upper Peruvian region toward Tucumán. Güemes prevented the enemy from establishing a stable position through guerrilla operations in the mountains of Salta and Jujuy until his death from illness and wounds on May 17, 1818. San Martín reorganized the Army of the Andes at Mendoza, crossed the mountains in 1817, and won at Maipú on March 5, compelling the Royalists to abandon Santiago. He entered Lima on June 15, but Callao remained under Royalist control, so Peru’s declaration of independence in 1814 had not yet produced a stable military result. In 1818, San Martín transferred command to José de San Lorenzo because of health, supply, and strategic disagreements and returned to Mendoza. Sucre then led the New Granada army beyond the Titicaca region, won at Junín on June 6, and occupied the heights at Ayacucho on December 9, enveloping La Serna’s withdrawal route and compelling his senior command to surrender. The destruction of the principal Royalist field army in southern Peru led Ayacucho to be treated as the military end of the Argentine War of Independence. Individual Royalist strongholds in the north continued resistance, and Peru completed its independent state arrangement in 1821. Argentina, Chile, and Peru established separate states, but the United Provinces did not obtain the Upper Peruvian territory, while Banda Oriental became the modern state of Uruguay only through a later process. Military victory therefore secured national survival without resolving every border question at once.
